snippet.title: "SUNSHINE LOVE" by MrDotsGames (Official Promotional Video)
snippet.description:
This is the official promotional video for "Sunshine Love", the third visual novel by MrDotsGames. 

It has now been completed and you can play the game in full. 
Please visit the official site for more details.

Credit to "EvilWolf" (video creator).
